summary.en: Run the strip in on the hook, pull the claims and one frame of each thing through the gate, punch to a contact sheet, pick one to run, run the strip out for the name.
summary.zh: 胶片跑入亮出钩子，主张和每件作品各一格穿过片门，冲到印样，挑一个放映，胶片跑出给出名字。

fits: Launches of something that makes or holds films: a video skill, a render tool, a model release with sample videos. 16–40 s.

intent.en: Tell the launch as one reel: words and frames through one gate, the set on one sheet, one pick.
intent.zh: 把发布讲成一卷胶片：字和画格穿过同一个片门，整组排在一张印样上，挑出一个。

content.en: A frame per film or style (3–12), their row strips and durations, 3–5 intertitles, the picked film’s frames, a source page.
content.zh: 每支片或每种风格一格（3–12），它们的缩略条和时长，3–5 张字幕卡，被选片的画格，一张来源页。

fits.zh: 会做影片或装着影片的东西的发布：视频 Skill、渲染工具、带示例视频的模型发布。16–40 秒。

notFor.zh: 没有画面的产品；数据故事。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
